functionality.label: 功能完整性
functionality.anchors: 10=覆盖全部职能边界且有实测增益; 7=主路径覆盖; 5=需人工补脚本; 3=频繁绕路; 1=核心缺陷未缓解

efficiency.label: 运行效率
efficiency.anchors: 上下文token税+命令往返+安装体积; 10=<400B主文件且链式高效; 5=12-30KB; 1=>30KB常驻+高失败重试

compatibility.label: 兼容性
compatibility.anchors: 对九端 junction 体系/中文 Windows/现有 memory 台账的适配成本; 10=零改造; 5=需 fork 适配; 1=架构冲突

documentation.label: 文档完善度
documentation.anchors: README/docs site/examples/CHANGELOG; 10=docs站+范例+变更史; 5=README 尚可; 1=无文档

community.label: 社区支持度
community.anchors: stars 增速/last commit/issue 响应/发布节奏; 10=周活跃+高响应; 5=月级; 2=>6月停更; 0=弃档

evidence_rule: each score row must cite at least one primary evidence item (repo URL fetch / local file:line / measured command)
